author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
The moon collapsed over horizons split
shattered space in
illuminating mysterious truths
as time melts
answers hang above broken canopies
towering conceptions move as the rabbit
dances
feet wrapped in dew fed grass
energy from within
fleeting realities in a world
undefined
